_readme: Nudges for the freeplay album, so it can be placed without rebuilding the game.
Edit, then back out of freeplay and go back in - it is read fresh every time.
Positive x moves right, positive y moves down. All of these are offsets from
where the code already puts things, so all zeroes is the built-in placement.
artScale multiplies the cover's size; 1 leaves it alone.
